data.name: 3D Ultra™ Minigolf Adventures
data.detailed_description:
Quer sejas um veterano, ou um novato, prepara-te para jogar um rápido e divertido jogo com quatro personagens com estilo. Usa o teu taco para percorrer os 36 divertidos percursos de minigolfe, num ambiente 3D com terreno elevado, bunkers, pontes e perigos aquáticos, entre outros obstáculos. Podes também escolher temas para se adaptarem ao teu humor, como Carnaval Clássico, Velho Oeste, e o Espaço Longínquo.
  • Percursos 3D cuidadosamente construidos — Vistas panorâmicas dos buracos e percursos alucinantes.
  • Modo multi-jogador para 4 pessoas — Escolhe de entre 4 personagens altamente detalhadas, cada uma com a sua personalidade e animações distintas.
  • 36 percursos desafiantes — Baseado em 3 temas: Carnaval Clássico, Velho Oeste, e Espaço Longínquo.
  • Adições criativas — Coleciona bonús e evita armadilhas inimagináveis para manter o paço de jogo excitante e imprevisivel.
  • Editor customizável — Cria o teu próprio percurso misturando e combinando pistas, junções, rambas, armadilhas, entre outros.

reviews.review:
I really wished that i liked this game, but it has multiple bugs on pc. xbox version was awesome but the pc version 

is missing features that the xbox version has. on pc, you cant go past 720p. while in xbox, it can run at 1080p (1K). i have also had a random bug on controller where if i press Y, the game would freak out. then return to normal after 2 seconds, kinda annoying since if i accidently press Y, it always freaks out no matter how many times you do it. and yes, 36 holes is nice, also 4 player local multiplayer too. i just cant stand the power-ups and some holes. sometimes the power-ups are delayed or they never happen when pressed. 



I also cant stand some holes, some have very weird physics, especially the space themed levels, one level if you go medium to hard, your ball flies off. on the rocket ship hole, the ball seems to have little to no drag. hitting low to medium can send you 75 percent of the way through the hole. some bugs on the carnival level. one would really stand out to me. on the spinning thing level, sometimes the ball can fly out or phase through it or never come out. sometimes resulting in a hole-in-one.
the putting controls are very limited and sometimes annoying. pc only has 2 or 3 putting options. 

the nice things about this game are the game doesn't require advanced specs for playing. that's all i can really point out for it.

i really wished that the pc version was better ported than it was. as it seems half-baked. while the xbox version has more features.

TL;DR. the game is fun but lacks certain features on the pc version, leaving it half-baked.
